response.sql: WITH budget_totals AS (SELECT link_to_budget, SUM(cost) as total_cost, COUNT(*) as expense_count FROM expense GROUP BY link_to_budget), avg_spend AS (SELECT AVG(total_cost) as avg_total FROM budget_totals), above_average AS (SELECT bt.link_to_budget, bt.total_cost, bt.expense_count, a.avg_total FROM budget_totals bt CROSS JOIN avg_spend a WHERE bt.total_cost > a.avg_total) SELECT AVG(total_cost) as average_total, SUM(expense_count) as total_expenses_count, AVG(total_cost - avg_total) as average_excess_above_avg FROM above_average
